acr_recovery_patch.name: OpenClaw Motor Wordflow - ACR Recovery Patch
acr_recovery_patch.objective: Recover OpenClaw as a Wordflow engine without UI using segmented, resumable ACR transfer and forensic audit logging.

segmentation.large_file_policy: do not rewrite source content; mark large objects for special handling

execution_model.continuation_rule: Each family may contain any number of numbered transfer segments.
execution_model.restart_recovery: Read the GitHub ledger and resume after the last verified segment.

dual_history.chat_history: Cumulative short log carried in every response.
dual_history.github_history: Authoritative machine-readable ledger committed to the destination branch.

recovery_protocol: Resume at the next unverified segment.
Never overwrite verified content without recording why.
Record every batch, byte count and SHA result.
At completion compare reconstructed tree against the pinned source manifest.
